bio.text: Jeff Van Drew represents New Jersey's 2nd Congressional District; he was elected to a fourth term on November 5, 2024, and sworn in on January 3, 2025.
He previously served three terms in the New Jersey General Assembly and four terms in the New Jersey State Senate.
He received a B.S. from Rutgers University and a D.M.D. from Fairleigh Dickinson University, and owned a dentistry practice in South Jersey for 30 years.
He is a member of the House Judiciary and Transportation and Infrastructure committees and lives in Dennis Township.
